description: A copy killed once the operation mkdir of its missing parent is journaled, before the folder is made, and a user making that folder meanwhile, private: the reprise finds a folder that is not the one of the inode its operation journaled right after a mkdir, and leaves it as the user made it, the operation undone with an op-undone event and no row saying it is Atoll's; the copy then goes into it. The reprise once finished on any folder there and gave it its model's mode (conformance/models/README.md, flaw 6).
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[[disk]]
id = "t1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1"
fs = "ext4"
[[disk]]
id = "t2"
uuid = "7a2b4c6d-8e0f-4a1b-9c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t2"
fs = "ext4"

steps.query: SELECT kind, state, COALESCE(file_key, '') FROM ops WHERE disk_id = 't2' AND kind = 'mkdir'
SELECT kind, state FROM ops WHERE disk_id = 't2' AND kind = 'mkdir'
SELECT count(*) FROM entries WHERE disk_id = 't2' AND created_by = 'atoll'
SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE kind = 'op-undone'
